what: GT-R12.2: live glasses assistance serving a guided task (GlassesLiveService with a LiveSession of kind Task).
device: Android emulator Medium_Phone_API_36.1 (arm64), debug build, Meta Mock Device Kit glasses fed by the emulator's virtual camera (a rendered living room). Not real glasses and not a phone.
task: T-4fa5a945c1d1 'Replace smoke detector batteries', step 6 of 7 'Reattach and test'. Opened read-only: live frames do not change a task, and no photo was taken.
observed: The step screen shows the new 'Use the glasses for this step' button (1-step-glasses-button.png).
Glasses assist opened with the step's instruction and 'Step 6 of 7 · Reattach and test'; mock glasses streamed and live assist ran at up to 5 tracking updates per second.

Guidance came from the task's step coach (genuine Muse and SAM calls in the API log, all 200): 'Point the camera up at the smoke detector on its ceiling base so it can be seen, then close it and press-hold test. Warn others nearby first as the test sound is loud.' (2-task-glasses-live-coaching.png). A task id sent to the inspection live endpoint would be refused before any model call.

Screenshot 2 also shows an Android system dialog: the emulator's Google speech engine kept stopping. That is the emulator's text-to-speech app, not LensQi; it was dismissed (3-task-glasses-tracking.png).
notTested: Real Ray-Ban Meta glasses, a phone, and a glasses photo becoming a step check.
